New Roofs and Re-Roofs

We strip old roofs off and re-roof them in new tiles or slates, from bungalows to houses with dormers, across North and North East Lincolnshire, Hull and East Yorkshire. Every new roof comes with our 10 year guarantee.

Call 01472 306134 WhatsApp Us

Stripped Back to the Rafters

A new roof starts with the old one coming off. The photos on this page are from our own jobs: the old tiles stripped and stacked on the roof, a breathable membrane rolled out over the rafters, and new battens fixed across it before a single new tile goes on.

Then the tiles go on row by row from the gutter up to the ridge. You can watch that happen on the bungalow in the video further down, which went from its old roof to a new one with the roof window back in.

Tiles, Slates and Dormers

The re-roofs here are in red and brown concrete tiles, and one terrace roof was re-slated, with the new slates going on beside the old mossy ones and the chimney kept. One dormer bungalow was re-roofed in brown tiles around its two dormers.

If you've had an emergency repair from us and decided the whole roof needs doing, that's fine too. A customer in Beverley did exactly that.

  • New roofs in Scunthorpe (DN15 and DN16), with the mess cleared up afterwards.

How Long It Takes

Most of our jobs take 1 to 3 days. The full re-roof in Grimsby above took two days.

Signs a Roof Needs Replacing

  • Slipped or cracked tiles in more than one place
  • Leaks that come back after they have been repaired
  • The felt under the tiles has perished and water gets in at the eaves
  • Tiles that have gone soft, flaky or porous with age
